THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 07.03.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:19798 WP(C) NO. 9121 OF 2025  3  T.R. RAVI, J.
 --------------------------------------------
 W.P(C). No. 9121 of 2025  --------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 7th day of March, 2025  JUDGMENT
The petitioner has preferred an application under 3G (5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, being dissatisfied with the award passed.
A copy of the application is produced as Ext.P4.
The petitioner seeks early disposal of the same.

In view of the limited prayer made, this writ petition is disposed of, directing the 2 nd respondent to consider and pass orders on Ext.P4 after hearing the petitioner and the representative of the NHAI,
at the earliest, at any rate, within eight months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.

Sd/-
